name: Mawzo the Dreadbomb
bio: Mawzo's motto? Speak softly, carry a big cannon – and have teeth that shred steel. While never seen without his fearsome Dreadcannon, skulduggery is his real weapon of choice. Why bother firing off a shot, when a single word will do? For his utter ruthlessness, he hopes that the people he's sent to sleep with the fishes don't take it personally. It's just business.
